hero.title: Meeting Notes
hero.description: Live transcription with action cards that appear as people speak. Watch your meeting turn into structured notes in real-time.

intro: Live transcription with action cards that appear as people speak. When someone says 'we need to schedule a follow-up' or 'John, can you handle this?' — action items surface inline in the document. HABOS identifies when tasks are assigned to you and highlights them in your personal view. Share meeting notes via a secure link — recipients see the full transcript and brief without creating an account. That shared link is also a growth engine: it captures leads, demos the product, and converts with targeted offers.

features.title: Live Action Cards
features.description: When someone says "we need to schedule a follow-up" or "John, can you handle this?", action cards appear inline in the document. Assign tasks, set reminders, or save items directly from the live transcript.

features.title: Watch to Computer Handoff
features.description: Start recording on your Apple Watch, then seamlessly hand off to your Mac when you want to see the live document. The transcription continues without interruption, picking up exactly where you left off.

features.title: Personal Action Items
features.description: VOIS identifies when tasks are assigned to you and highlights them in your personal view. Tap to add them directly to your task list or edit them on the spot. It's magical watching your to-dos populate automatically during the meeting.

features.title: Word-of-Mouth Design
features.description: When colleagues see action items appearing in real-time on your screen during meetings, they'll want it too. This feature is designed to spread organically—from individual professionals to small teams to entire enterprises.

steps.title: Start Recording
steps.description: Tap the record button on your watch or open VOIS on your Mac. Transcription begins immediately.

steps.title: Watch the Magic
steps.description: As people speak, words appear on screen. When action items are mentioned, AI-generated cards pop up inline suggesting next steps.

steps.title: Act on Items
steps.description: Tap cards to add tasks to your list, schedule follow-ups, or save important information. Your personal items are automatically highlighted.

steps.title: Share & Export
steps.description: Meeting over? Export the full transcript with action items, or share specific sections with your team.

cta.title: Ready to transform your meetings?
cta.description: Meeting Notes is included in the VOIS for Work plan.
